table.name: TLGNS_SAP_VENDOR_PORG
table.description: Purchasing Organisation Data of a Vendor as received from SAP in Purchasing Organisation Data data segment in VN interface.

column.name: SAP_VENDOR_PORG_ID
column.description: PK. Technical key generated by Logon, does not have a corresponding attribute in SAP.

column.name: SAP_VENDOR_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_vendor. The vendor this purchasing organisation data belongs to. (SAP: defined by E1LFA1M_LIFNR)

column.name: PURCHASINGORG_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_purchasingorg_bs. The purchasing organisation. (SAP: defined by E1LFM1M_EKORG).

column.name: LAST_SUCCESSFUL_HJID
column.description: Contains the hjid of the most recent successfully imported notification or null in case the most recent one has failed. Non-enforced FK to ULGNSAP.VN_VENDORNOTIFICATION.

column.name: LAST_FAILED_HJID
column.description: Contains the hjid of the most recent notification for which the import has failed or null in case the most recent one was successful. Non-enforced FK to ULGNSAP.VN_VENDORNOTIFICATION.

column.name: MARKED_FOR_DELETION
column.description: Deletion code in SAP (E1LFM1M_LOEVM). 0=active, 1=deleted. Note that Logon normally has active_flag, with inverse logic. We stick to SAP standards in the tlgns_sap_... tables.
